args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled back checkout-api in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed successfully; all regions now serving v2.3.0. Investigation into the root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures is still needed.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** (the most recent release that was healthy in production) across all regions — all three regions are now serving v2.3.0.
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer. It includes a description of the failures and the rollback performed.

Note: The root cause of the v2.3.1 failures still needs investigation before redeploying that version.
